title: Lead Data Engineer
description: We help companies get compensation right. What we get paid at work has a massive impact on our lives, and it’s one of the biggest factors in hiring and retaining talent - and yet so many companies struggle to get it right. They simply have no choice but to rely on poor data and unsophisticated tools for their pay decisions. That’s why we created Ravio. We help many of the world’s most innovative and ambitious companies build stronger teams and reach their goals through better compensation. Our real-time data platform brings compensation into the modern age, tracking the market across all compensation types from salary to equity and benefits. We’re passionate about ensuring everyone is paid what they deserve, no matter their background or circumstances. We believe that when compensation is done right, everyone wins. Ravio is growing fast, which means you can too. We’ve established ourselves as the European leader in our space serving more than 1,200 clients, and now have our sights set on becoming the global go to place for compensation data and tools for managing compensation. Joining a startup and scaling it into a global product is one of the most challenging and rewarding experiences a career can offer. If that sounds exciting to you, you’re in the right place. The role We’re looking for a Lead Data Engineer to lead a small team of data engineers within our Engineering team. You’ll remain hands-on in designing, building, and operating the data systems behind our compensation benchmarks, customer-facing tools, and AI agents. You’ll take a platform engineering approach to data, building reliable, reusable capabilities that help Engineering, Data Science, and Insights deliver. You’ll combine technical leadership with line management and coaching, working with engineering and product colleagues to turn priorities into delivered outcomes. You’ll report to our VP Engineering. Hands-on engineering and delivery Be a senior technical contributor, building and operating the pipelines, integrations, and data services behind Ravio’s product. Design clear interfaces between ingestion, transformation, and downstream applications so teams can build on trusted data without bespoke support for every change. Shape and deliver the data roadmap with Product, Data Science, and Insights. Prioritise improvements that deliver customer value, reduce recurring manual work, or address reliability needs, while keeping complexity and cloud costs under control. Build data quality, governance, and security into everyday delivery through automated checks, clear data ownership, and appropriate access controls. Work with engineering colleagues to integrate data systems into shared development, deployment, and monitoring practices. Use version-controlled transformations, automated tests, and repeatable deployments, reducing bespoke tooling where it adds unnecessary overhead. Own the reliability and day-to-day support of the team’s production data systems, improving monitoring and recovery. Build reusable ingestion patterns and self-service workflows around recurring needs, measuring their value through faster delivery, fewer failures, and less manual support. Use AI-assisted tools for development, testing, documentation, and investigation. Help the team use them effectively, with appropriate review of outputs and protection of customer data. Team management and leadership Lead the team’s delivery planning and ways of working, keeping priorities, scope, and dependencies visible. Take part in shared product prioritisation, bringing requests from Data Science, Insights, and Operations into an agreed delivery plan. Partner with software engineers, product managers, and data colleagues to make timely decisions and share responsibility for delivered outcomes. Line manage and coach a small team of data engineers, providing regular feedback and supporting their technical and career development. Build a supportive, accountable team with shared ownership of its systems. Use pairing, code reviews, documentation, and operational handovers to spread knowledge. What we’re looking for Six-plus years’ experience in data engineering, with at least two years in a team leadership role. Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience building and operating production data systems. Experience with data modelling, transformation frameworks such as dbt, and workflow orchestration. Experience applying platform engineering principles to data systems, such as reusable ingestion patterns, clear data interfaces, or self-service tooling that other teams use successfully. Experience with cloud infrastructure, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD). Practical understanding of reliable data processing, including schema changes, retries, safe reprocessing, and backfills. Experience using monitoring and data quality checks to investigate failures and improve reliability. Practical use of AI-assisted engineering tools, with sound judgement about verification, security, and where automation adds value. Proven ability to mentor engineers, set team goals, and deliver value for users and the business. Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with a bias for action. Excellent listening and communication skills. How you work You speak the language of engineers and data scientists, and are comfortable working with Product, Customer Success, Operations, and founders. You bring empathy and strong social and emotional intelligence, with an ability to put yourself in others’ shoes. You take satisfaction in solving challenging problems and helping a talented team deliver effectively. Our tech stack Data Engineering Python and SQL dbt for data transformations dlt for data extraction and loading Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Cloud Functions, Workflows, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and Datastream PostgreSQL Data Science Python (polars, pandas, scikit) Jupyter notebooks SQL and dbt Infrastructure and delivery GitHub Actions Terraform Artifact Registry Data engineering at Ravio Data is central to Ravio’s product. As we expand our compensation tools and build AI-powered experiences, we need reliable ways to bring customer data in and make it available across the platform. You’ll help a small team deliver that work alongside software engineers, data scientists, and product colleagues. Success means useful capabilities reaching customers, dependable data for colleagues, and less time spent on avoidable support and manual processes. Why join Ravio? Opportunity to be a critical team member in a high-growth startup. A blend of hands-on engineering and leadership, giving you both direct impact and career growth. Remote-friendly, flexible work culture with a high degree of ownership. Work on meaningful problems that help people get paid fairly and competitively in their careers. Compensation and benefits £100,000 - £120,000 salary Company ownership (everyone gets a meaningful equity stake in Ravio) 37 days paid time off (25 days holiday + 4 wellness days + 8 public holidays) Up to 6% pension matching scheme £60 a month wellness allowance (Invest in your physical wellbeing, on us) Private healthcare cover (on a medical history disregarded basis) with AXA Personal worldwide travel insurance - just in case Income protection insurance (for full peace of mind in case you cannot work because of sickness or disability) 16 weeks fully paid birthing parent leave, followed by 4 weeks at 50% pay. For non-birthing parents, we offer 8 weeks fully paid leave. #LI-Hybrid Compensation: £100K – £120K • Offers Equity • £100K – £120K • Offers Equity Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Fraud Analyst
description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role We are looking for a Fraud Analyst to join Pleo’s Decision Intelligence team and help strengthen how we detect, prevent, monitor, and respond to fraud risk across our financial crime decisioning setup. This is not a traditional Fraud Operations case-handling role. You will work closer to the decisioning layer: helping translate fraud patterns into rules, monitoring rule performance, supporting rule testing, reviewing alert behaviour, and making sure fraud controls remain effective, explainable, and proportionate. You will join at an important stage as Pleo continues to mature its fraud and AML decisioning capability. The right person will help improve speed, resilience, and quality in how we create, test, deploy, monitor, and tune fraud rules. What you’ll be doing You will help operate and improve Pleo’s fraud decisioning capability, with a focus on card fraud and related financial crime risk scenarios. Your responsibilities will include: Supporting the end-to-end fraud rule lifecycle: from rule proposal and analysis through testing, deployment, monitoring, tuning, and rollback. Working directly in, or closely with, decisioning tools and rule engines to support fraud detection logic. Analysing fraud patterns, alert trends, false positives, false negatives, and rule performance. Translating FraudOps insights and stakeholder requests into clear, structured rule proposals. Helping assess whether new rules or threshold changes are justified by data. Monitoring post-deployment rule performance and identifying when rules need adjustment. Supporting daily operational requests related to fraud controls, while ensuring changes are traceable and well documented. Partnering with FraudOps, AML, Product, Engineering, Data, Compliance, and Legal to make sure decisioning changes are aligned and risk-aware. Maintaining clear documentation for fraud rules, rationale, expected impact, testing outcomes, and monitoring results. Helping reduce single points of failure by building repeatable processes and stronger business continuity around fraud decisioning. What we’re looking for We are looking for someone who combines fraud domain knowledge with practical experience working in a decisioning environment. You should have: Experience as a Fraud Analyst, Risk Analyst, Fraud Strategy Analyst, Fraud Rules Analyst, Decisioning Analyst, or similar. Hands-on experience with a decisioning tool, fraud rules engine, risk platform, or internal decisioning system. Experience creating, testing, monitoring, or tuning fraud rules, thresholds, scenarios, or risk logic. Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data to assess rule performance and fraud patterns. Good understanding of fraud typologies, especially card fraud, transaction fraud, account misuse, or payment fraud. Ability to balance fraud prevention with customer impact and operational workload. Experience working with false positives and understanding that good fraud controls require continuous monitoring and tuning. Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain rule logic, rationale, risks, and expected outcomes clearly. Comfort working cross-functionally with FraudOps, Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Data teams. A structured mindset and appreciation for documentation, traceability, governance, and change control. Fintech, banking, payments, spend management, or regulated financial services. SQL or basic data analysis. What success looks like In your first 3 months, success would look like: You understand Pleo’s fraud decisioning setup and can confidently support day-to-day rule operations. Fraud rule requests are better structured, documented, and traceable. Rule changes are supported by data, clear rationale, and expected impact. Post-deployment monitoring is more consistent and visible. FraudOps and DI have a stronger operating rhythm for proposing, reviewing, deploying, and tuning fraud controls. Why join us? This is a rare opportunity to help shape a growing decisioning function from the inside. You will not just be reviewing fraud alerts, you will help define how fraud detection logic is built, governed, monitored, and improved. You will join a team that is building the foundations for more scalable, data-driven, and resilient financial crime decisioning. If you enjoy working at the intersection of fraud strategy, operations, data, systems, and product, this role will give you real ownership and impact. Apply if this sounds like you You are analytical, structured, curious, and comfortable challenging assumptions. You know that fraud rules are never “set and forget.” You understand the importance of balancing risk reduction, customer experience, operational workload, and governance. Most importantly, you have worked with decisioning tools or rule-based risk systems before and want to help build a stronger fraud decisioning capability at scale. The location Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work . We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations. Show me the benefits! Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work About your application English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us. A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails. Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us. Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you. Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here . Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role. Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: Hilbert is a scalable, data science-first growth engine that gives B2C teams predictive clarity into user behavior, revenue drivers, and the actions that drive sustainable growth. Fully agentic by design, Hilbert shrinks months-long decision cycles to minutes. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.</li> <li>Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.</li> <li>Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.</li> <li>Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.</li> <li>Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.</li> <li>Travel perks. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.</li> <li>Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.</li> <li>Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Our Cultural Pillars:</strong></p> <p><strong>Traveler first</strong></p> <p>We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us. </p> <p><strong>Execution is our edge</strong></p> <p>We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>WHAT MAKES US EPIC?</h2> <p>At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.</p> <p>Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.</p></div><h2>ENGINEERING - EPIC RESEARCH</h2> <h3><strong>What We Do</strong></h3> <p>Epic Research conducts state-of-the-art research in machine learning, AI, character animation, and digital humans. We work with leading universities and product teams to bring new research into games like Fortnite, Unreal Engine, MetaHuman, and the tools creators use every day.</p> <h2>MACHINE LEARNING RESEARCH INTERNSHIP AT EPIC GAMES</h2> <h3><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h3> <p>Epic Games is looking for current PhD students and recent PhD graduates (within 12 months of graduation) for paid research internships, working on state-of-the-art machine learning across our ecosystem. Epic makes Unreal Engine, which powers creative work across many industries, alongside some of the world's most popular games, including Fortnite and Rocket League. Through these products, ML research at Epic reaches millions of creators and players every day. AI is reshaping the games industry, and Epic Research - led by Lucia Specia and Michael Black - is at the center of that shift. We're looking for talented interns who want to be part of it.</p> <h3><strong>In this role, you will</strong></h3> <p>Work with our team of research scientists and engineers at the intersection of vision, language, speech processing, embodied agents, and game development to create state-of-the-art machine learning models in a range of areas - research topics of interest include:</p> <ul> <li><strong>AI-backed interactive characters:</strong> LLMs for conversational characters, memory systems, automated evals, animation, etc.</li> <li><strong>Game agents: </strong>vision-language-action, game-state agents, etc.</li> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>3D human and object tracking</strong></li> <li><strong>Reinforcement learning </strong>for embodied behavior</li> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>Speech systems and conversational agents</strong></li> <li><strong>World building and game logic generation</strong>: video models, 2D->3D scene building, etc.</li> <li><strong>AI-assisted game development</strong>, e.g. the next generation of Epic Developer Assistant for UE and UEFN</li> <li><strong>Embodied and physical intelligence</strong> including human-object interaction</li> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>Multi-modal diffusion models</strong></li> <li><strong>Player safety</strong>: AI-alignment, content moderation, etc.</li> <li><strong>Improved user experience</strong>: personalised game recommendation, game representation, spam detection, etc.</li> <li><strong>Content localization</strong>: (multimodal) translation, quality assurance, etc.</li> <li><strong>Model distillation for realtime performance</strong></li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we're looking for</strong></h3> <ul> <li>An ongoing or recently completed (within the last 12 months) PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, AI or a related field</li> <li>A record of publication in top conferences/journals</li> <li>Experience implementing deep learning algorithms for problems in computer vision, natural language processing, or speech/audio processing</li> <li>Hands-on knowledge of state-of-the-art ML methods, such as Transformers, diffusion models, and reinforcement learning</li> <li>Experience with post-training foundation models, including SFT, preference training, and reinforcement learning</li> <li>Excellent AI coding and experimental engineering skills</li> <li>Desirable: game development experience in either C++ or C#</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Internship Details</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Duration:</strong> 5-12 months initially (depending on your location), with flexible start-dates throughout 2026/2027</li> <li><strong>Hours:</strong> full-time (40 hours/week) or part-time (20 hours/week)</li> <li><strong>Location:</strong> Select regions within the UK, US or Canada</li> <li><strong>Employment Authorization</strong>: You must hold an existing right to work in the UK, US or Canada for the full duration of the internship - Visa sponsorship or support is unavailable for this role</li> <li><strong>Publishing</strong>: Research by Epic interns is regularly published in top-tier conferences</li> </ul> <p><em>This internship has a flexible start date in 2026/2027. Recruitment will be ongoing until teams find an ideal match. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the posting location for the duration of the internship. For more information about Epic’s Early Career Program, visit <a href="https://www.epicgames.com/site/en-US/earlycareers">epicgames.com/earlycareers</a>. This is going to be Epic!</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2>ABOUT US</h2> <p>Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.</p> <h3><strong>Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!</strong></h3> <p>Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy <a href="https://www.epicgames.com/site/en-US/eeo-policy" target="_blank">here</a>.</p> <p><strong>Note to Recruitment Agencies: </strong>Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found <a href="https://www.epicgames.com/note-to-recruitment-agencies" target="_blank">here</a>.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <p><strong>Department Overview:</strong></p> <p>Our Technology Infrastructure team operates globally and is responsible for every aspect of the firm's hybrid platform. This ranges from our EUC/Office environments to Trading and Core service Co-Location Data Centres, and extends to Public Cloud, delivering top-tier technology services to a dynamic and demanding Trading organisation.<br><br>In addition to meeting the round-the-clock operational demands of the platforms, we continuously evolve and transform our platforms to maintain a competitive edge that our business requires. We innovate to provide valuable solutions and leverage our skilled Technology teams to deliver against rapidly changing business requirements.</p> <p><strong>Role Overview: </strong></p> <p>As a member of our London-based Infrastructure and Platform Engineering team, this position supports our multi-tenant private and public cloud initiatives.</p> <p>The role contributes to the delivery of services to our core business areas globally, including Trading, middle and back office, and Technology. The role requires an understanding of platforms including Windows, virtualisation and their associated technologies, delivered through on-premises, hosted and public cloud environments. It involves system integration, support and continuous improvement, with an emphasis on standardisation, repeatability, automation and orchestration.</p> <p>The successful candidate will cover BAU rota activities alongside business project initiatives. We are looking for a proactive self-starter who can manage their workload, identify opportunities for improvement and work alongside senior engineers to develop their experience in solution design, scoping and architecture across our key technology platforms.</p> <p>With the team’s broad technology remit, this role would suit someone early in their Windows platform engineering career who is keen to build their experience in a fast-paced environment and gain exposure to a wide range of technologies.</p> <p><strong>Experience Required:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A minimum of 5 years of industry experience. Prior experience in a similar role within a Financial institution will be advantageous.</li> <li>Comprehensive platform engineering and support experience biased towards the Microsoft server technology portfolio, including On-premise bare metal hardware deployments (preferably HPE), Advanced virtualisation design, architecture and support across VMware and Microsoft Hyper-V platforms, together with container technologies such as Kubernetes. This role requires excellent organisational skills, open communication, and a collaborative approach.</p> <p>Your commitment to continuous improvement should be evident, both in learning from others and sharing knowledge to enhance our team's capability and function.</p> <p> </p> <p><em>BlueCrest is committed to providing an inclusive environment for its workforce. Whether at WPP or at Amazon, every project is an OpenDoor on new possibilities. Anything and everything can be an opportunity for our people to drive <em>impact</em> – for them to innovate, learn, thrive, and occasionally fail too.</p> <p>The unique OpenDoor partnership model is built to deliver next level Productivity, fueled by our industry-leading approach to People, Platforms, and Process. OpenDoor spans across all WPP agencies and disciplines such as media, business consultancy, communications and brand strategy, tech and commerce, public relations, and production.</p> <p>OpenDoor’s values are built from Amazon’s own <a href="https://www.amazon.jobs/content/en/our-workplace/leadership-principles"><strong>16 Leadership Principles</strong></a>, and WPP’s core values of Open, Optimistic and Extraordinary. Together, when WPP’s Creative Transformation meets Amazon’s next-level customer centricity, our people come together to challenge and impact what’s done today and build a better future.</p> <p>By joining OpenDoor, not only are you joining a cross-function team partnering with one of WPP’s top five global clients, but you are also taking a step to challenge yourself and the world around you every day, working in the most unusual way on some of Earth’s most ambitious opportunities in marketing, tech, media, business, and creativity.</p> <p>ABOUT THE ROLE</p> <p>We are searching for a talented and enthusiastic individual to join our OpenDoor team as a Implementational Planning AD. This is a full-time position based in London. The Role will report to WPP Solutions Partner and will manage a matrixed team of digital planners, in channel activation and offshore teams. This role plays a crucial part in supporting WPP's mission to deliver consistency, delivery excellence and best in class service for Amazon in every country across its diverse businesses, including XCM, Prime Video, and RMI.</p> <p>The Role is focused on Prime Video’s European markets.</p> <p>The Implementational Planning team creates an effective link between the Strategy & Planning teams and Activation, data and tech teams. They are also developing and supporting the delivery of tasks such as reporting output, offer insights and recommendations across strategic planning and agency pitches.</p> <p>RESPONSIBILITIES</p> management of Digital cross channel planning, digital in channel planners and digital implementation, social activation teams, programmatic activation teams.</li> <li>In this role you will also lead with your directors direct pan regional IO / partnerships buys which focus on deal based pan regional buying i.e. (multi-market IO Twitch, Yahoo, XBOX deals)</li> <li>Integrate the expertise of data experience strategies across biddable & digital touchpoints, identify strategic opportunities for proprietary solutions growth in service of solving client business problems.</li> <li>Be the driving force on the selection and application of systems, tools and platforms, proprietary solutions, enabling them with the proper resources and knowledge for successful implementation.</li> <li>Police the delivery of all tools and technology within WPP Open (our tech and tools operating system) for Amazon Devices.</li> <li>Outline advanced data analytics/measurement frameworks to shape holistic digital scopes and services where they add value.</li> <li>Leads the development, presentation, and delivery of top-quality cross-channel planning work for larger campaigns.</li> <li>Plans against client outcomes – quantifying objectives and the likely impact of comms on them across all biddable practice areas, in collaboration with practice leads.</li> <li>Scrutinizes performance planning budgets, of assigned accounts, to identify strengths and weaknesses and ensures proper financial allocations and ensures WPP Open and Amazon’s goals are protected and driven.</li> <li>Develop an and executive.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Collaboration & Leadership: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Work in a complex, matrixed environment, influencing stakeholders and leading cross-functional teams towards our practical application in a business context.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Project & Stakeholder Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ambiguity Navigation: The ability to manage innovation projects from start to finish, creating structure, clear plans, and milestones where none existed before.</li> <li>Cross-Functional Collaboration: A talent for building coalitions and working with diverse teams (e.g., Technology, Finance, People) to get pilot projects off the ground and secure their expert contribution.</li> <li>Influential Communication: The ability to articulate the goals, progress, and outcomes of innovation projects to a wide range of stakeholders, including senior leadership, building excitement and buy-in along the way.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Candidate Requirements</strong></p> <ul> AI/automation and a deep understanding of how they can be applied to drive business value.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Measures of Success</strong></p> <ul> <li>Within 6 Months: You will have taken title: Head of Financial Planning & Analysis
location: Home Based - Americas; Home based - EMEA; Office Based - London, UK
description: <p>We are hiring for the <strong>Head of Financial Planning & Analysis</strong>, to lead the global FP&A Teams and be a leader within the wider finance team. You will play a key part leading our monthly business reviews and forecasting, annual planning, and continuously drive cross-functional business alignment, as well as develop the long term roadmap for the FP&A team. Our ideal candidate is a highly analytical independent thinker, who has a proven record of leading a team to use data analysis to advise on critical financial, commercial and strategic decisions.</p> <p>Our business opportunity is significant; we can deliver both infrastructure and business applications to the enterprise market. As companies refresh their data centers, our goal is to be the platform for cloud and apps. As they re-architect their business applications to embrace open source, our goal is to deliver the majority of their databases, analytics, messaging, publishing, identity, security, workflow... everything that is open source. We are committed to do that at the most efficient price points possible to drive down the total cost of IT, but this is nevertheless a significant global market, and our ambition is to be counted among the most valued software suppliers to the Global 10,000.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This is a remote role in AMER or EMEA time zones, with the option to be based in our London office.</p> <h3>The role entails</h3> <ul> <li>Develop executive reporting dashboards and documents including Board reporting, monthly financial results and other management presentations</li> <li>Analyse & Report monthly results, leading indicators and KPIs to support monthly forecasting and annual plan attainment</li> <li>Provide commercial analysis, develop growth targets, and evaluate strategic initiatives</li> <li>Work with product managers to produce, aggregate, and distribute both market insights and competitive intelligence</li> <li>Manage financial models, including budgeting, forecasting, and long range planning</li> <li>Drive improvements in data analysis, and determine the appropriate processes, methodologies, and modeling techniques to deliver insights.</li> <li>Partner with Accounting and Investor Relations to support month end close, flux review processes, and financial reporting</li> <li>Drive multi-functional change projects designed to enhance systems, processes, and data accuracy</li> <li>Play a key role in preparation of critical public financial documents to support an IPO process, including supporting the production of investor materials and public filings</li> <li>Guide the annual FP&A activity calendar to provide decision support to the executive team</li> <li>Mentor colleagues within the FP&A team, as well as peer teams</li> <li>Control costs via methodical reviews of department spend, procurement strategies, and business wide process efficiency</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>An exceptional academic track record</li> <li>Experience and a deeply rooted passion to lead successful team members, and aid in their career growth </li> <li>Have operated in a high growth, multi currency/geography technology business with a mixed go-to-market motion</li> <li>Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities</li> <li>Highest ethical standards, integrity, authenticity, credibility, and character</li> <li>Curiosity and willingness to work on a wide range of projects</li> <li>Proficiency in spreadsheets, financial modeling, and BI tools</li> <li>Understanding of core accounting principles </li> <li>Professional written and spoken English </li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability </li> <li>Passionate, thoughtful, and self-motivated</li> <li>Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet and exceed commitments </li> <li>International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <h3>Nice-to-have skills</h3> <ul> <li>MBA or equivalent combination of professional certifications and experience</li> <li>Previous experience as a subject matter expert in Financial Planning & Analysis</li> <li>Experience with Business Intelligence reporting, CRM and ERP systems</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We assess performance and revisit compensation twice annually to ensure we recognize outstanding colleagues. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review</li> <li>Company recognition rewards</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

title: General Counsel (Office based)
description: <p>We are hiring a <strong>General Counsel</strong>, reporting to the Chief Operating Officer (COO). This role leads Canonical’s global Legal and Compliance function.</p> <p>This is a unique opportunity for an <strong>exceptional and commercially-minded senior lawyer</strong> to lead the legal and compliance function of a profitable, fast-growing technology company that is privately held with the intention to list on a public exchange. description: <p><strong>The role of an Accounts Payable Clerk at Canonical</strong></p> <p>We have an exciting opportunity for an Accounts Payable Clerk to join our growing team. title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Operations
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰Competitive base salary and stock options |<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a></strong></p> <p><strong>Help build the future of customer operations</strong></p> <p>We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Operations is at the heart of that mission. It’s where we help millions of customers, solve complex problems and keep Monzo safe. Now, we’re redesigning how customer operations work by bringing together intelligent automation, human expertise and world-class technology.</p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Staff Technical Program Manager</strong> to lead complex company wide programmes driven by the Operations collective. You’ll turn ambitious ideas into clear plans, bring a large and varied group of partners with you and help teams deliver lasting change.</p> <p>This role is about more than keeping work on track. You’ll shape how we work across the collective, influence domain and collective leaders across Monzo, connect technical delivery to operational outcomes and make sure change works for the people who use it every day.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p><strong>Lead programmes that cut through all operational domains at Monzo</strong></p> <p>You’ll lead high-impact programmes from strategy through to measurable outcomes. These may cover AI-powered customer support, tools that help our Customer Operations teams, or the platforms and processes behind millions of operational decisions.</p> <p><strong>Build strong partnerships at every level</strong></p> <p>You’ll work with a large and varied group of partners. This could include frontline Operations teams, subject matter experts, product and engineering teams, risk and compliance partners, senior leaders and executives.</p> <p><strong>Drive change, not just delivery</strong></p> <p>You’ll help the whole collective adopt new ways of working. You’ll understand how changes affect people, processes and technology, then build that into the programme from the start.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead end-to-end planning and execution of major product or platform programs that cross multiple teams and markets</li> <li>Manage cross-collective programmes: <ul> <li>Define programme roadmaps and milestones, set priorities, manage trade-offs, identify and manage the critical path and risks, ensure alignment with the business goals and ambition</li> <li>Collaborate and communicate with multiple stakeholders, both technical and non-technical across the business to ensure alignment and speed of delivery</li> <li>Manage dependencies, timeline and the sequencing of delivery</li> </ul> </li> <li>Drive effective decision making to remove blockers</li> <li>Ensure operational effectiveness across your collective/area</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have strong experience managing complex technology programmes or products from inception to launch</li> <li>You’re an exceptional communicator who can create clarity for technical and non-technical audiences</li> <li>You are comfortable working in a global business with a presence in multiple markets and want to be part of scaling this further</li> <li>You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles to get stuff done, and are able to thoughtfully and constructively challenge and influence the people you work with</li> <li>You can make complex work easy to understand without losing the important detail</li> <li>You understand how functionality comes together (across products and platforms) to deliver value for users, and can proactively identify and mitigate delivery risks, and can propose and drive a technical solution</li> <li>You are comfortable personally diving deep into the data to make good decisions in complex situations where there’s often no “right answer”</li> <li>You can influence across teams even when you don’t manage them directly and can influence senior leaders, resolve disagreement and build alignment without relying on authority.</li> <li>You’ve driven organisation-wide change and can show how you supported adoption, not only delivery</li> </ul> <p>You don’t need to match every point. If you’re excited by the role and believe you could have an impact, we’d love to hear from you.</p> <p><strong>What makes this role different</strong></p> <p>Most companies are adding AI to existing support processes. We’re redesigning the operating model itself.</p> <p>You’ll help shape how intelligent automation and human expertise work together in a highly regulated environment. The programmes you lead will affect how teams across Operations work and how millions of customers get help.</p> <p>You’ll have the scope to influence strategy, the responsibility to turn it into action and the chance to build ways of working that scale.</p> <p><strong>How we work 💻:</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations & Flexible Working : </strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. </p> <p>We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. </p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨</p> <p>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>The interview process:</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong>Recruiter Call (30 mins)</strong> You'll meet our Engineering Leadership Recruiter to discuss your experience and learn more about Monzo. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular program execution and technical leadership. They’ll also make time to tell you about Monzo and answer your questions.</li> <li><strong>Loop Stage (3 hours)</strong> The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability).</li> </ol> <p>All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. If you’d like to ask a question sooner, email <a href="mailto:tech-hiring@monzo.com">tech-hiring@monzo.com</a></p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰Base salary range for this role is dependent on experience + equity + stock options & benefits</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"><strong>here</strong></a></p> <p>#LI-SS2</p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. It’s how our customers move, receive, spend and manage their money, from cards and bank transfers to cross-border payments, merchant acquiring, payment experiences in the app, and the platform infrastructure that underpins the whole bank.</p> <p>This role sits in our Payments Platform area, working most closely with our Finance Infrastructure squad. The squad sits in Payments, but partners deeply with Finance teams to build the systems, abstractions and capabilities Monzo needs to operate safely, scale efficiently, and expand into new markets. You’ll work on foundational financial infrastructure: the ledgers, data, controls, reporting, reconciliation and platform capabilities that help Monzo understand, account for and manage money across the bank.</p> <p>This is a role for someone who gets genuinely excited by complex, technical infrastructure. The work is often behind the scenes, but it’s business-critical: it helps Monzo scale, launch new products and markets, support Finance, and keep the bank running safely.</p> <p> </p> <h4>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</h4> <ul> <li>Defining the product strategy and roadmap for Finance Infrastructure within Payments Platform.</li> <li>Partnering closely with Engineering, Finance and Payments leaders to understand what Monzo needs from its financial systems today and as we scale.</li> <li>Moving the team from reactive delivery towards a more strategic, product-led approach, asking why we’re building things, what good looks like, and how today’s choices support Monzo’s long-term needs.</li> <li>Translating complex finance, accounting, operational and regulatory needs into scalable platform capabilities.</li> <li>Prioritising across competing stakeholder needs, balancing urgent delivery with long-term system health.</li> <li>Helping Monzo build financial infrastructure that can support multiple products, entities, countries, currencies and regulatory environments.</li> <li>Building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Finance, Engineering, Product and Operations.</li> <li>Bringing strong product discipline, technical curiosity and systems thinking to a space that is critical to Monzo’s future growth.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h4>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</h4> <ul> <li>You’re a strong senior Product Manager with experience owning complex technical, platform, infrastructure or financial systems.</li> <li>You have enough technical depth to partner credibly with engineers and reason about systems, trade-offs, dependencies and long-term architecture.</li> <li>You’re excited by “boring but critical” infrastructure, things like ledgers, reconciliation, financial data, controls, reporting, internal platforms, abstractions or backend systems.</li> <li>You can work with senior and cross-functional stakeholders, including Finance, Engineering, Product and operational teams.</li> <li>You’re comfortable bringing product thinking into ambiguous or stakeholder-heavy environments, and moving teams from request-led delivery towards long-term strategy.</li> <li>You’re high-agency, ambitious and excited to stretch yourself in a team with a high bar.</li> <li>You care about customers and business outcomes, even when the work is several layers removed from the end customer experience.<br><br></li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box?
